summary: Dripmetric is a revenue-leak detector for small self-serve software teams. It puts product usage and, optionally, payment events on one event schema, runs nine readable leak rules (such as onboarding stall, trial ended unpaid and high-intent user went quiet), scores buying intent from 0 to 100 with transparent rules, and sends masked alerts to Slack or Discord plus a weekly leak report. It needs no billing integration, has a free plan, and is in private beta.
inventory_evidence: Next.js app in apps/site: the routes / (src/app/page.tsx), /privacy, /leaks, /buying-intent, /docs, /pricing, /guides/trial-to-paid-conversion and /compare/posthog (src/app/**/page.tsx) are the only canonical pages; the guide pages render content/pages/*.md. Legacy v1 paths (/login, /signup, /dashboard, /terms) are permanent redirects, not pages; unknown paths render src/app/not-found.tsx with a 404 status.
refresh_trigger: Regenerate with `pnpm site:markdown` whenever src/content/site.ts, a section in src/components/home, the privacy page or a file in content/pages changes. The guide pages are rendered from the same Markdown files, so their copies cannot drift; review content/index.body.md against the rendered home page first.
